_comment: How an uploaded image is named (ADR-197 point 9). Decided at implementation,
per installation, like brand_profile.json; a changed template names new
uploads only. The name is searchable metadata, never the served path.
Placeholders: {brand} the brand's permanent key, {date} upload day as yyyymmdd, {n} the running number that day
in this brand, {width} and {height} in pixels, {name} the typed name
(lowercased, spaces to hyphens, special characters spelled out or dropped),
{product_id} if given. The extension follows the file's real type.
